//AllowedHosts: Replace * with the API's real hostname before going live.
//Cors: Scheme+host only - no trailing slash and no path, or the origin never matches and every request fails CORS. AllowAnyOrigin is not usable here because the refresh cookie makes requests credentialed.
//Jwt: Key lives here because runasp.net shared hosting gives no way to set an environment variable for the worker process, and the app refuses to start without one. Prefer Jwt__Key in the environment on any host that supports it. Rotating this value signs out every session at once.
//RefreshTokenCookie: Assumes the frontend reaches this API through its own /api/* proxy, so the browser sees one HTTPS origin and the cookie is first-party: Lax is correct and Secure is honoured because the response the browser receives is HTTPS, even though this app answered the proxy over plain HTTP. If the browser is ever pointed straight at this host instead, both values are wrong - a direct cross-site call needs SameSite=None, which requires Secure, which requires TLS this host does not have.
//Bootstrap: Credentials are absent on purpose. Supply Bootstrap__SuperAdmin__Email and Bootstrap__SuperAdmin__Password as environment variables for the first boot against an empty database; the bootstrap is idempotent and never creates a second Super Admin.
